items.title: PSX Gains 17.5% in a Month: Can Refining Strength Keep the Run Going?
items.summary: Phillips 66's 17.5% monthly rally rides on stronger refining margins and midstream growth, but valuation and lower 2027 earnings temper the upside.

items.title: Will Tight Product Inventories Boost PARR's Refining Outlook?
items.summary: Par Pacific's refining network benefits from tight global product inventories and resilient demand, which are expected to support refining margins in the near term.

items.title: Is DK a Buy Now as Cash Flow Improves Despite Refining Cycle Risks?
items.summary: Delek's cash flow is improving as refining margins and optimization efforts gain traction, while low valuation, leverage and regulatory uncertainty shape the case.

items.title: Three-Year ORLEN Deal Enhances EQNR's Crude Sales & European Reach
items.summary: Equinor's three-year ORLEN deal strengthens crude sales visibility and expands its energy footprint across Poland and Europe.

items.title: Can Phillips 66, Marathon, or Valero Afford Delek US Holdings Now?
items.summary: Delek US Holdings has surged past its own analyst targets after a stunning 215% one-year run, and its CEO just said all options are on the table. The question is whether any strategic buyer can still justify the price.

items.title: What ExxonMobil Told You Before The Oil Shock Arrived
items.summary: Two downstream start-ups and an early deepwater delivery were readable weeks ahead; the price that made them pay was not.

items.title: Trump’s Latest Gasoline Move Could Cut Prices—and Increase Smog
items.summary: The EPA is allowing an earlier switch to cheaper winter-grade gasoline, potentially shaving 10 to 30 cents a gallon off prices. The relief may be short-lived.

items.title: WTI Surges, Yet Phillips 66's Refining Backdrop Looks Supportive
items.summary: PSX could benefit from tight global fuel supplies, low inventories and high crack spreads, even as WTI above $85 raises refiners' input costs.
